description: Defines an interface for providing environment statistics and a readonly struct that encapsulates various system and process resource usage metrics.

classes.name: EnvironmentStatistics
classes.description: A struct representing various processed environment and resource usage statistics, optimized for frequent creation with filtering applied to resource metrics.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentStatistics
methods.description: Method signature in the interface for retrieving current environment statistics.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing CPU and memory usage in human-readable format.
